app.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
app.privacy.s1.title: 1. Data Controller
app.privacy.s1.body: The data controller is Javier Garcia Mateos (tax ID 07991565P), Avenida de los Tulipanes 30, 46185 La Pobla de Vallbona (Valencia), Spain, owner of Money Manager (winjgm.com). Contact: moneymanager@outlook.es. The server is hosted by Hetzner Online GmbH (Helsinki, Finland), within the European Union, so processing is governed by the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
app.privacy.s2.title: 2. Data We Collect
app.privacy.s2.intro: To provide the service we collect only the strictly necessary data:
app.privacy.s2.item1: Name and email address (registration and authentication).
app.privacy.s2.item2: Password (stored encrypted with bcrypt; never in plain text).
app.privacy.s2.item3: Optional profile picture (an image you upload yourself).
app.privacy.s2.item4: Personal financial data: transactions (amount, description, category, date), categories, budgets and automation rules you enter.
app.privacy.s2.item5: JWT session tokens, stored on your device (localStorage).
app.privacy.s3.title: 3. Purpose and Legal Basis
app.privacy.s3.intro: We use your data exclusively to:
app.privacy.s3.item1: Provide the personal finance management service (legal basis: contract performance, Art. 6.1.b GDPR).
app.privacy.s3.item2: Send transactional emails: account verification and password reset (legal basis: contract performance).
app.privacy.s3.item3: Generate AI financial analysis at your explicit request (legal basis: explicit consent, Art. 6.1.a GDPR).
app.privacy.s3.noMarketing: We do not carry out marketing, profiling or behavioural analysis.
app.privacy.s4.title: 4. Third Parties and International Transfers
app.privacy.s4.p1: We do not share your data with third parties for commercial purposes. The only providers involved are:
app.privacy.s4.item1: Hetzner Online GmbH (server hosting, EU — no transfer outside the EEA).
app.privacy.s4.item2: Cloudflare Workers AI (AI analyses, Premium only): the aggregated figures of the month are sent when you ask for an analysis and, when you import a statement, the movement descriptions without long numbers (IBANs, cards). Cloudflare does not use this data to train models.
app.privacy.s4.item3: Cloudflare (CDN and DNS): handles network traffic. See their policy at cloudflare.com/privacypolicy.
app.privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Retention
app.privacy.s5.p1: Your data is retained while you maintain an active account. If you delete your account, all your data is permanently erased within a maximum of 30 days.
app.privacy.s5.p2: Stripe keeps payments and invoices for as long as tax law requires, even if you delete your account.
app.privacy.s6.title: 6. Security
app.privacy.s6.p1: We apply the following technical measures:
app.privacy.s6.item2: Passwords hashed with bcrypt (high cost factor).
app.privacy.s6.item3: Authentication via short-lived JWT tokens with refresh token.
app.privacy.s6.item4: The server does not log personal data in access logs.
app.privacy.s7.title: 7. Your Rights (GDPR)
app.privacy.s7.intro: As a user you have the right to:
app.privacy.s7.item1: Access: request a copy of your data.
app.privacy.s7.item2: Rectification: correct inaccurate data from your profile.
app.privacy.s7.item3: Erasure ('right to be forgotten'): delete your account and all associated data.
app.privacy.s7.item4: Portability: export all your data as JSON, or your movements as CSV, from "Settings → Your data".
app.privacy.s7.item5: Objection and restriction of processing: contact us at any time.
app.privacy.s7.item6: Complaint: if you believe we have violated your rights you may lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es) or your local supervisory authority.
app.privacy.s8.title: 8. Cookies and Local Storage
app.privacy.s8.p1: This application does not use tracking or analytics cookies. It only uses the browser's localStorage to maintain your session (JWT token) and your language preference. This data is not shared with third parties.
app.privacy.s8.p2: To know whether the service works we keep aggregated, anonymous counters on our server (for example, how many signups or purchases there were each day). They contain no personal data, are not linked to any account and we use no third-party analytics tools.
app.privacy.s9.title: 9. Minors
app.privacy.s9.p1: The service is not directed at persons under 16 years of age. If you are under 16, you must not create an account or provide us with personal data.
app.privacy.s10.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
app.privacy.s10.p1: We may update this policy occasionally. We will notify you via an in-app notice. The last updated date will always be visible at the top of this page.
app.privacy.s11.title: 11. Account Deletion
app.privacy.s11.p1: You can permanently delete your account and all associated data directly from within the app at any time. No email or external form is required.
app.privacy.s11.step1: Open the app and log in.
app.privacy.s11.step2: Tap the profile icon (top right) to open your profile.
app.privacy.s11.step3: Scroll down and open the "Settings" section.
app.privacy.s11.step4: Tap "Delete account" and confirm in the dialog.
app.privacy.s11.p2: Upon confirmation, your account and all data (transactions, categories, budgets, recurring rules and profile picture) are permanently and irreversibly deleted from our servers.
app.privacy.contact.title: Contact
app.privacy.footer: © 2026 Javier Garcia Mateos · Money Manager · winjgm.com

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.s1.title: 1. Service provider
terms.s1.body: Money Manager is provided by Javier Garcia Mateos, tax ID (NIF) 07991565P, address Avenida de los Tulipanes 30, 46185 La Pobla de Vallbona (Valencia), Spain. Contact: moneymanager@outlook.es.
terms.s2.title: 2. Plans
terms.s2.body: The Free plan costs nothing and has usage limits (accounts, budgets, goals, automations and alerts). Premium removes those limits and adds bank statement import, trends and net worth analysis and the AI advisor (with a monthly maximum of analyses). Prices are shown in euros, VAT included. In addition, the tax return draft reader (which reads your draft and suggests deductions) is not part of the free trial: it is included after more than 2 months of paid Premium or with the tax return pass.
terms.s3.title: 3. Free trial
terms.s3.body: New accounts get 14 days of Premium at no cost and without a card. Afterwards the account moves to the Free plan and keeps all its data.
terms.s4.title: 4. Payment, renewal and cancellation
terms.s4.body: Payments are processed by Stripe; we never receive your card details. Before paying you must accept these terms; we keep the date and the version you accepted. Monthly and yearly subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period until you cancel them in "Your plan → Manage subscription". After cancelling you are not charged again and you keep Premium until the end of the period already paid; the unused part of the period is not refunded. The Founder plan is a one-time payment that grants Premium for as long as the service is available. The tax return pass is a one-time payment of 10 € (VAT included) that gives 30 days of use of the draft reader and of the tax return calculator without limit; it is not a subscription and does not renew. If you buy it in the Android app, Google Play processes the payment.
terms.s5.title: 5. Right of withdrawal
terms.s5.body: Premium starts as soon as you pay. That is why, when you buy, we ask you to expressly request that immediate start and to acknowledge that you therefore lose the 14-day right of withdrawal; we confirm it by e-mail together with the purchase. Before paying you get a 14-day free Premium trial to decide. All of this without prejudice to the rights the law grants you as a consumer. The same applies to the tax return pass: it is activated as soon as you pay.
terms.s6.title: 6. AI and partner offers
terms.s6.body: AI-generated analyses are for guidance only and are not financial advice. The "Offers" section contains sponsored links labelled as such, which you can hide in Settings. The tax return calculator and the draft reader are for guidance only: they do not replace the Tax Agency or a tax adviser, and the return is always your responsibility. The PDF of your draft is read on your device and is not uploaded to our servers.
terms.s7.title: 7. Invoicing and VAT
terms.s7.body: Prices include the applicable VAT (21% in Spain). After each payment you will receive the receipt or invoice by e-mail from Stripe. If you need an invoice with your tax details, write to moneymanager@outlook.es with your name, tax ID and address.
terms.s8.title: 8. Changes to prices and terms
terms.s8.body: We may change the prices or these terms. If they change, we will notify you in the app with reasonable notice and, for subscriptions, before the next renewal; the new price does not apply to the period already paid. If you disagree, you can cancel before renewal.
terms.s9.title: 9. Availability and liability
terms.s9.body: We do our best to keep the service available but do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation. Money Manager is an organisation tool: it does not provide financial, tax or legal advice, and the decisions you make with its data are your responsibility. Except where the law does not allow it, our liability is limited to the amount you paid in the last 12 months.
terms.s10.title: 10. Customer support and complaints
terms.s10.body: For any question, payment issue or complaint write to moneymanager@outlook.es; we will reply as soon as possible. If you are not satisfied with the answer, as a consumer you may go to the consumer bodies of your region or to the courts.
terms.s11.title: 11. Governing law
terms.s11.body: These terms are governed by Spanish law. Consumers may go to the courts of their place of residence.

app.tour.welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to Money Manager!
app.tour.welcome.body: Let me show you how everything works in a couple of minutes. Move on with "Next" (or the arrow keys) and leave whenever you want with "Skip the tour" or Esc.
app.tour.monthNav.title: 📅 Pick the month
app.tour.monthNav.body: "‹ Previous" and "Next ›" move between months, and "Go to current month" brings you back to today. Everything below belongs to that month. If your month starts on another day (for example, payday), change it in Settings.
app.tour.options.title: ⋯ Month options
app.tour.options.body: Export the month's movements to CSV (for Excel) and import your bank statement as CSV or Norma 43: the app detects the columns, skips duplicates and suggests categories. Importing is a Premium feature.
app.tour.summary.title: 📊 Month summary
app.tour.summary.body: Income, expenses and savings of the month, the balance, your savings rate and the available balance, which adds what is left from previous months. If a budget or an alert goes off, the warning shows up right above.
app.tour.newTransaction.title: ➕ Add a movement
app.tour.newTransaction.body: Choose the type (expense, income or saving), the amount, the description, the category, the account and the date. In the category list, "Manage categories" lets you create, rename or delete your own, with their emoji and colour.
app.tour.movements.title: 📋 Your movements
app.tour.movements.body: See them by day, by week or on a calendar with the tabs above. Edit or delete any movement and add notes right from the list. Further down there is the expenses-by-category chart.
app.tour.aiAdvisor.title: 🤖 AI financial advisor
app.tour.aiAdvisor.body: It analyses your month and gives you a summary, what you are doing well, warnings and saving tips. You get 1 free AI analysis a month; with Premium it is 10 a month, and it only uses the month's aggregated figures. It is guidance, not financial advice.
app.tour.menu.title: ☰ The menu
app.tour.menu.body: This button takes you to every section. Let's go through them one by one.
app.tour.annual.title: 📊 Yearly balance
app.tour.annual.body: Income, expenses and savings of every month of the year in a chart and a table, with the totals. Change the year with the arrows and press a month to open it.
app.tour.analysis.title: 📈 Analysis
app.tour.search.title: 🔎 Search
app.tour.search.body: Find any movement by its description or notes and filter by type, category, account, dates and amount. You can edit them from the results too.
app.tour.accounts.title: 🏦 Accounts
app.tour.accounts.body: Split your money into accounts (current, savings, cash, card, investment…) with their opening balance, choose the default one and record transfers between them: moving money counts neither as an expense nor as income.
app.tour.budgets.title: 🎯 Budgets
app.tour.budgets.body: Set a monthly limit for each category. The month summary shows a progress bar per category, and we warn you at 80 % and when you go over.
app.tour.goals.title: 🏁 Savings goals
app.tour.goals.body: Create a goal (a trip, a car…) with its target and, if you like, a date. Each goal uses a category: Saving movements in that category fill it up, and we tell you how much to save each month to make it on time.
app.tour.automations.title: ⚙️ Automatic movements
app.tour.automations.body: For what repeats (salary, rent, subscriptions): set the amount, category and frequency (monthly, every 2 months, quarterly or yearly) and the movement is created by itself in each period, from the start month to the end month.
app.tour.alerts.title: 🔔 Alerts
app.tour.alerts.body: Create your own warnings: for example, when your expenses go over 80 % of what is available, when you save less than 10 % of your income or when a category goes over an amount. They show up in the month summary.
app.tour.plan.title: ⭐ Your plan
app.tour.plan.body: Here you see your plan, the trial days you have left and how much of each Free plan limit you use.
app.tour.offers.title: 🎁 Offers

landing.meta.title: Money Manager: track your spending and save more | Free

landing.hero.subtitle: Record your spending, set budgets by category and see if you make it to the end of the month. Simple and ad-free.

landing.features.privacy.title: Your data stays yours

landing.plans.title: Free to start
landing.plans.body: The free plan lets you keep your accounts and try the tax return calculator once. Premium (€2.99/month) adds forecasts, import, receipts by e-mail, debt plan, unlimited tax return, AI analysis, couple mode and unlimited limits.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.free.a: Yes. The free plan includes what you need to keep your finances. When you sign up you get 14 days of Premium without a card, then you decide.
landing.faq.safe.a: Your data is stored on servers in the European Union, the connection is encrypted and you can lock the app with a PIN or fingerprint. You can export it or delete your account at any time.
landing.faq.bank.q: Can I import my bank movements?
landing.faq.bank.a: Yes, by uploading the statement as CSV or Norma 43. We recognise the CaixaBank, BBVA, Santander, ING and Revolut formats and categorise the movements automatically.
landing.faq.mobile.a: Yes. There is an Android app on Google Play and the website works on any phone; you can add it to your home screen like an app.
landing.faq.cancel.a: Whenever you want and without penalty, from “Your plan”. You keep Premium until the end of the period already paid.
landing.faq.who.a: Money Manager is built and maintained by one person in Spain. Write to us at moneymanager@outlook.es.

tools.loan.title: Mortgage and loan calculator: monthly payment
tools.loan.description: Work out the monthly payment of a fixed-instalment mortgage or loan, the total you will pay and how much of it is interest. Enter the amount, the rate and the years.
tools.loan.disclaimer: Fixed-instalment calculation at a constant rate. It does not include fees, insurance or rate changes: always ask your bank for the binding offer. Not financial advice.
tools.vat.title: VAT calculator: add and remove VAT
tools.vat.description: Work out the VAT of an invoice: add VAT to an amount without it, or split an amount that includes VAT into base and VAT. Rates of 21%, 10%, 4% and 0%.
tools.vat.disclaimer: Indicative calculation with a single VAT rate. Check the right rate for each operation with your adviser.
tools.inflation.title: Inflation calculator: what your money is worth over the years
tools.inflation.description: See how much purchasing power your money loses to inflation: what an amount will be worth in a few years and how much you will need to buy the same.
tools.inflation.worth: It will be worth, in today's euros
tools.inflation.needed: You will need to buy the same
tools.inflation.disclaimer: Assumes constant inflation, which varies every year in reality. An estimate to understand the effect, not a forecast.
tools.goal.title: Savings goal calculator: how long will it take?
tools.goal.description: Work out how many months or years it takes to reach your savings goal from what you have, what you add each month and the estimated return.

tools.goal.disclaimer: Simulation with a constant return: the real one may vary and is not guaranteed. Not financial advice.

tools.renta.loadError: The deductions of your region could not be loaded. Try again.

tools.renta.shared: I claim them together with my partner (each takes 50 %)
tools.renta.ascendants: Parents or grandparents in your care

tools.renta.pension: Own contribution to a pension plan (per year)

tools.renta.deductionsHint: Tick the ones you think apply and see how much they would give you. Under each one you can read the requirements and the official link. Deductions lower what you pay directly.

tools.renta.line.base: Base the tax is calculated on
tools.renta.line.minimum: Personal and family minimum (taxed at zero)
tools.renta.minimumTitle: What your family situation saves you
tools.renta.minimumHint: The family minimum is not a fixed percentage: it is a part of your pay that stops paying tax. What you save is that amount times the lowest rate of the scale (around 19 %).
tools.renta.disclaimerFull: Indicative estimate with the {year} income tax rules for residents of common-regime communities, with one payer and individual filing. app.tour.business.body: Prepare the draft of your quarterly self-employed taxes: type your income and expenses and get modelo 303 (VAT) and modelo 130 (income tax) with their boxes, what you can deduct from each expense, your estimated contribution and the deadlines. Free accounts can prepare 1 draft; with Premium, as many as you want.

tools.renta.draft.applied: It is already in the calculator: check every figure, reading may fail depending on the format.
tools.renta.draft.noneMissing: I see no more deductions to ask you about with your data.
tools.renta.draft.locked: Reading your draft is not included in the free 14-day trial. It unlocks after more than 2 months of paid Premium, or you can use it now with the 1-month pass.
tools.renta.draft.unlocksOn: With your paid Premium it unlocks on {date}.
tools.renta.draft.passHint: Read your draft and calculate your tax return as often as you want for 30 days. It is not a subscription: it does not renew.
tools.renta.draft.passUntil: Your tax return pass is active until {date}.
tools.renta.draft.refused: The use could not be registered: your access to the draft reader has changed. Reload the page.
tools.renta.draft.goFirst: Go to the first marked deduction ({count})
tools.renta.pending: {count} marked deduction(s) still need an amount: they do not count until you fill it in.
tools.renta.goToPending: Go to the deduction that is missing
tools.renta.draft.scenarioOn: You are trying the {year} tax return with the same income and properties as your draft, one year older. Change your children and anything that has changed (for example, a baby on the way) and see the result. The 2025 rules are used until the new ones are published.
tools.renta.advance: You can collect it every month, without waiting for the return, by asking for the advance payment with form {model}.
tools.renta.draft.immediate: I want the pass to start now and accept that I therefore lose the 14-day right of withdrawal
app.autonomo.title: Prepare your self-employed tax draft
app.autonomo.hint: From your professional income and expenses we prepare the draft of modelo 303 (VAT) and modelo 130 (income tax advance), with the boxes of the form, your estimated contribution and the deadlines.
app.autonomo.hardToJustify: Apply hard-to-justify expenses (5 %, up to 2,000 € a year, simplified direct estimation)
app.autonomo.exempt: I am a professional and last year at least 70 % of my income was withheld (no modelo 130)
app.autonomo.priorNetHint: If it was 12,000 € or less there is a reduction in modelo 130.
app.autonomo.toOffset: VAT to offset from earlier quarters
app.autonomo.freeOne: Your free account includes 1 draft. With Premium, as many as you want.
app.autonomo.usedFree: You have already prepared your free draft (you can see it below). With Premium you prepare as many as you want, every quarter.
app.autonomo.irpf.notRequiredText: With 70 % of your income withheld last year, as a professional you do not file modelo 130.
app.autonomo.perMonth: a month (from your income so far)
app.autonomo.irpfBoxes: Modelo 130: income tax advance (cumulative figures of the year)
app.autonomo.retaText: With what you have this year, your monthly net income would be about {net} (after the 7 % general expenses). You fall in bracket {bracket}: contribution base between {baseMin} and {baseMax}.
app.autonomo.retaNote: The contribution is {rate} % of the base. It is a forecast: Social Security settles the next year with your real income. If you are on the flat rate, you pay the reduced fee of your sign-up.
app.autonomo.disclaimer: Indicative draft with the 2026 rules: it does not include investment goods, pro rata, special regimes or intra-EU operations, and public holidays are not taken into account in the dates. Check it with your adviser before filing anything.
app.autonomo.manualHint: Type your income without VAT by rate and each expense with the VAT included. We tell you how much you can deduct from each one. Modelo 130 is cumulative (it adds up the whole year to the quarter you choose), which is why the earlier quarters are needed: if they are alike, use “Copy” so you do not type everything again. What you type is saved on this device.
app.autonomo.profile: Your situation (valid for the whole year)
app.autonomo.workArea: Square metres of your home used for work
app.autonomo.homeArea: Total square metres of the home
app.autonomo.healthPeople: People covered by your health insurance
app.autonomo.vehicleExclusive: I use my vehicle only for the activity (transport, sales…)
app.autonomo.healthDisability: One of those people has a disability
app.autonomo.note.supplies: Only 30 % of the share of the home you use for work.
app.autonomo.note.vehicle: With mixed use it is not an expense for income tax; only 50 % of the VAT is deducted.
app.autonomo.note.meals: Limit of 26.67 € a day paying by card in restaurants.
app.autonomo.note.clients: It is an expense, but the VAT is not deducted.
app.autonomo.note.health: Up to 500 € per person a year (1,500 € with a disability).
app.autonomo.deductibleTitle: What you can deduct from your expenses
app.autonomo.toOffsetHint: VAT from earlier quarters you have not yet offset (box 110).
app.tour.autonomoDraft.title: 📄 Draft of the quarter
app.tour.autonomoDraft.body: Choose the year and the quarter, fill in the data and press “Prepare my draft”. At the end you can download it as a PDF to send to your adviser, already organised. It is an indicative estimate: check it with your adviser before filing.
app.tour.autonomoManual.title: ✍️ Your data, by hand
app.tour.autonomoManual.body: Enter your income and expenses for each quarter (with their VAT) once, plus the square metres of your workspace and your home. We use them to work out which expenses you can deduct: supplies, vehicle, meals, health insurance, hard-to-justify costs…
app.tour.autonomoShortcuts.title: ⚡ Shortcuts to save time
app.tour.autonomoShortcuts.body: In the 4th quarter you do not need to fill in the earlier ones: tick that you already filed modelo 130 and copy its totals. And “Copy the previous quarter” starts you from the same usual expenses.
app.tour.rentaDraft.title: 📎 Import your draft
app.tour.rentaDraft.body: Upload the PDF of your Tax Agency draft: we read it on your device, fill in your data and ask about the deductions you have not ticked and could claim. You can also try next year's return with the same data. It is included after 2 months of paid Premium or with the 10 € pass.
app.autonomo.pdf.title: Self-employed tax draft
app.autonomo.pdf.hint: With all the data and the boxes, ready to send to your adviser.
app.autonomo.pdf.error: The PDF could not be created. Try again.
app.autonomo.priorOn: I already filed modelo 130 for the earlier quarters: use its totals so I do not type them again
app.autonomo.priorHint: Copy the figures of your last modelo 130 filed this year. Expenses are those of box 02 (they already include the hard-to-justify ones). That way you only fill in the quarter you are preparing.
app.autonomo.pdf.prior: Totals of the modelo 130 already filed: income {income}, expenses {expenses}, earlier payments {payments}, withholdings {withheld}
app.tour.invest.title: 📈 Invest
app.tour.invest.body: A map of the 12 investment classes with their Spanish taxation, chapters on index funds, stock markets, bonds and crypto, market hours with an open/closed indicator, simulation charts and calculators. It is educational content, free for everyone, and not personalised advice. Long chapters are in Spanish.
app.invest.title: Invest
app.invest.hint: Understand how investments work, how they are taxed in Spain and what risks they carry. No jargon, with examples. Long-form texts are in Spanish.
app.invest.disclaimer.title: Important notice
app.invest.disclaimer.edu: Educational content: not personalised financial advice or a recommendation to buy or sell. This app is not a licensed advisor.
app.invest.disclaimer.past: Past performance does not guarantee future results.
app.invest.disclaimer.risk: Crypto and leveraged products can lose all the capital invested, and in some cases more.
app.invest.disclaimer.advisor: Talk to a financial adviser or tax adviser before deciding. Tax rules change and every case is different.
app.invest.disclaimer.figures: Figures, examples, charts and calculators are illustrative and rest on simple assumptions.
app.invest.disclaimer.short: Educational content, not personalised advice. Illustrative figures; past performance does not guarantee future results.
app.invest.map.lead: The 12 main investment classes. Open each card to see what it is, how it makes money, its risk and liquidity, pros and cons, an example and its taxation in Spain. Card texts are in Spanish.
app.invest.map.taxNote: General summary for information only; confirm it with a tax adviser, especially in Navarra, the Basque Country or if you are not a tax resident.
app.invest.heat.title: Comparison: risk, liquidity and taxation
app.invest.heat.hint: The redder, the riskier; for liquidity, green is the easiest to sell. The last column shows the type of taxation.
app.invest.glance.title: IRPF and VAT at a glance
app.invest.glance.hint: The rules that come up most often with investments. The savings scale comes from the app’s own tax-return data (2026 campaign, tax year 2025).
app.invest.glance.scaleNote: Rate per band (State plus region). Only the part inside each band pays its rate. Navarra and the Basque Country have their own regime.
app.invest.glance.verify: General rules written to educate: rates, limits and requirements can change every year. Verify them with a tax adviser or the Tax Agency.
app.invest.learn.lead: {total} chapters to understand funds, stock markets, bonds and crypto, with charts and calculators.
app.invest.learn.spanishOnly: The text of this chapter is in Spanish only.
app.invest.markets.title: Exchange hours
app.invest.markets.lead: When each exchange opens and closes, in local time and in Spanish time, and whether it is open right now.
app.invest.markets.note: Regular hours calculated from your device clock, with no connection to any service. Holidays and early closes are NOT included and exchanges can change their schedules: always check the official calendar.
app.invest.charts.lead: Illustrative simulations to see how prices move. They are generated with random numbers and are not real data of any asset.
app.invest.chart.foot: Illustrative simulation, not real data. It predicts nothing.
app.invest.chart.vol.title: Volatility: bonds, stocks and crypto
app.invest.chart.vol.note: Three made-up assets from the same starting point (100) over 5 years. Logarithmic vertical axis.
app.invest.chart.vol.desc: Line chart: the bond-like asset barely moves, the stock-like one rises and falls clearly and the crypto-like one swings widely.
app.invest.chart.dd.title: Maximum drawdown
app.invest.chart.dd.note: Top: the price of a stock-like asset over 10 years; bottom: how far below its previous peak it is at each moment.
app.invest.chart.dd.desc: Line chart of the simulated price over ten years.
app.invest.chart.dd.underDesc: Chart of the percentage below the peak, always zero or negative.
app.invest.chart.dd.result: Largest fall in this simulation: {depth}. It took {months} months to regain the peak from the low point.
app.invest.chart.dd.never: Largest fall in this simulation: {depth}. In this case it did not regain the peak before the period ended.
app.invest.chart.hor.title: Time horizon changes the range of outcomes
app.invest.chart.hor.note: What 100 invested in a stock-like asset (assumed 7 % average yearly return and 16 % volatility) would be worth after N years. Light band: worst 5 % to best 5 % of 600 simulations; dark band: 25th to 75th percentile.
app.invest.chart.hor.desc: Chart with the median and two outcome bands that widen over the years.
app.invest.chart.bond.title: Bond price and interest rates
app.invest.chart.bond.note: Bonds with a 3 % coupon: the higher the yield the market demands, the lower the price. The 10-year bond moves far more than the 2-year one.
app.invest.chart.bond.desc: Downward curve: the bond price falls as the required yield rises.
app.invest.chart.lev.title: Leverage: amplified gains and losses
app.invest.chart.lev.note: Return on your margin depending on how far the price moves, with different leverage. At the red line you lose the whole margin (liquidation).
app.invest.chart.lev.desc: Lines get steeper with more leverage and are cut at −100 %.
app.invest.calcs.lead: Four calculators that run on your device and send no data anywhere. They are indicative only.
app.invest.calc.invalid: Check the inputs: amounts and years must be above zero (60 years at most).
app.invest.calc.compound.title: Compound growth with an index fund or ETF
app.invest.calc.compound.intro: How much you could have with a monthly contribution, after fees, inflation and tax. It assumes a constant return, which does not exist in reality.
app.invest.calc.compound.withTax: Apply Spanish tax on withdrawal (savings base)
app.invest.calc.compound.feeImpact: With a 0 % fee you would have {amount} more
app.invest.calc.compound.chartDesc: Contributed, central scenario, and pessimistic and optimistic scenarios with {spread} points less and more return.
app.invest.calc.compound.etfNote: Fund vs ETF: in Spain a fund lets you transfer without tax until you withdraw; with an ETF, selling to switch product is taxed. Here a single withdrawal at the end is assumed, so the tax is the same.
app.invest.calc.compound.footnote: Tax uses the savings scale from the app’s data, with no other savings income that year. Results are illustrative.
app.invest.calc.crypto.title: Crypto, leverage and periodic purchase
app.invest.calc.crypto.intro: Simulate how much you would win or lose with a leveraged position and where its liquidation price is. Simplified model: real platforms may calculate it differently.
app.invest.calc.crypto.invalid: Check the inputs: margin, prices and leverage between 1 and {max}.
app.invest.calc.crypto.liquidated: Position liquidated: you lose the whole margin.
app.invest.calc.crypto.risk: Warning: trading with leverage can wipe out your margin within minutes. This is not a recommendation.
app.invest.calc.crypto.riskHigh: Very high risk: with this leverage a small price move liquidates the position. Many retail traders lose all their capital with products like this.
app.invest.calc.crypto.dcaIntro: Compare investing a fixed amount at each price in a list with investing everything at the start.
app.invest.calc.crypto.dcaHint: Separated by commas or spaces, with a decimal point. A made-up illustrative path by default.
app.invest.calc.crypto.dcaInvalid: Enter at least two prices and an amount above zero.
app.invest.calc.crypto.dcaLump: If you had invested everything at the start
app.invest.calc.crypto.dcaChartDesc: Line with the price at each purchase.
app.invest.calc.bond.title: Bonds: price, yield and net return
app.invest.calc.bond.intro: Work out a bond’s price from the yield the market demands, what happens if it changes and what is left after Spanish income tax.
app.invest.calc.bond.shockHint: In percentage points, positive or negative
app.invest.calc.bond.netTitle: Net return after tax if held to maturity
app.invest.calc.bond.otherHint: Interest, dividends and gains each year
app.invest.calc.bond.footnote: Yearly coupons are assumed, each taxed in the year it is paid, plus the difference to face value at maturity. Inflation is not deducted.
app.invest.calc.tax.title: How much tax will my gain pay?
app.invest.calc.tax.intro: Applies the savings-base scale (interest, dividends and sales of investments) to a gain.
app.invest.calc.tax.gainHint: After subtracting losses of the same year
app.invest.calc.tax.other: Other savings income of the year
app.invest.calc.tax.otherHint: Interest and dividends already adding up
app.invest.calc.tax.withheldHint: For example, 19 % from a Spanish fund
app.invest.calc.tax.toPay: To pay in the tax return
app.invest.calc.tax.footnote: Scale from the app’s tax-return data (tax year 2025). Indicative: it leaves out reductions and the specifics of your case or of Navarra and the Basque Country.
app.invest.disclaimer.key2: It is educational content only, to learn how the products work.
app.invest.disclaimer.key3: Percentages, amounts, taxes and limits can change over time, by product and with your situation: check them with official sources.
app.invest.varies: For educational use only, not an investment recommendation. Percentages and amounts are indicative and may change.
